identity_impact: Immutable lifecycle commands, transitions, policy decisions, observations, blockers, and exact owner-result references receive canonical SHA-256 identities linked to the frozen Research Brief and Campaign; private claims and projections are non-canonical and rebuildable.
evidence_level: Campaign lifecycle and orchestration explanations only; no single-run metrics, execution truth, budget ledger, runner truth, or research qualification is recreated.
fail_closed_behavior: Reject tampered campaign roots, illegal transitions, stale predecessors, same-key semantic conflicts, multiple successors, unconfirmed owner records, and uncertain crash recovery as paused with a structured reconciliation_required blocker; never launch duplicate work or add an eighth lifecycle state.
